operators.name: sigmoid_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise sigmoid: output = 1 / (1 + exp(-input)) for each element.
Input and output are N-dimensional tensors with identical shape and contiguous layout.
No broadcasting or bias; only elementwise transformation.
Elementwise sigmoid activation applied to input tensor x.
Output shape [1024, 1024, 512], dtype float32, device CUDA, contiguous.
Returns the sigmoid-activated tensor without further modification.
